label: old-bridge-start-client
characteristics: The full Start preview client module (platform-owned, part of the bridge identity: previewBridgeIdentity counts THEME_PREVIEW_START_CLIENT_PATH for a Start preview) as each old bridge fixture's source commit generated it. Byte-identical at all three commits. It imports only documentPreviewRuntimeChannel and parseEditorToPreviewWindowEvent from the protocol module, which every old fixture exports; today's client also imports documentPreviewIdentity, which two of the three old protocol modules lack.
howGenerated: git archive <sourceCommit> src tsconfig.json into a scratch directory, then themePreviewStartClientSource() from src/lib/storefront/compiler/theme-preview-start-runtime.ts written out by tsx. The same bytes came out for all three commits.
storage: Stored as .txt so nothing here is typechecked, linted or bundled.
